options.explanation: Atmosphere ✓ — the gases surrounding the Earth or another planet. Here, planet-scale gaseous layer. This is the most precise replacement.

Ambient air — the surrounding environmental air, especially in monitoring contexts. It is not best because it is technical environmental language, too specialised here; the clue is planet-scale gaseous layer.
Fresh air — clean or refreshing air, especially from outdoors. It is not best because it is adds a clean/refreshing meaning not necessarily present; the clue is planet-scale gaseous layer.

Wind — air moving on a larger scale. It is not best because it is larger-scale moving air, too dynamic or too strong; the clue is planet-scale gaseous layer.
Ventilation — the process of supplying and removing air. It is not best because it is a process rather than the air itself; the clue is planet-scale gaseous layer.

options.explanation: Air current — a movement or flow of air from one place to another. It is not best because it is requires directional movement; the clue is simple explanatory wording.
Breeze — a light, gentle movement of air. It is not best because it is specifically gentle moving air; the clue is simple explanatory wording.
Moving air ✓ — air that is in motion. Here, simple explanatory wording. This is the most precise replacement.
Oxygen — one gas component of air. It is not best because it is only one component of air; the clue is simple explanatory wording.
Atmosphere — the gases surrounding the Earth or another planet. It is not best because it is planetary/large-scale and too broad for local airflow; the clue is simple explanatory wording.
Ventilation — the process of supplying and removing air. It is not best because it is a process rather than the air itself; the clue is simple explanatory wording.

falseSynonyms.zh: 氧氣 ≠ air 氧氣只是空氣中的一種成分。
風 ≠ air wind 是大規模移動中的空氣。
微風 ≠ all air breeze 只表示輕柔流動的空氣。
大氣 ≠ every use of air atmosphere 偏宏觀氣體層。
通風 ≠ air ventilation 是換氣過程，不是空氣本身。
氣流 ≠ still air airflow 只表示空氣流動。
只在清新／戶外 air sense 接近 fresh air 加入 clean/refreshing 意味。
詞形陷阱 air 是名詞／動詞；airy 是形容詞。
